projects.name: Commecs AI Assistant
projects.tagline: College information, with sources in reach.
projects.summary: A multilingual college information assistant that brings public college material into a conversational interface with links to its sources.
projects.imageAlt: Commecs Assistant welcome screen, with program and admission prompts
projects.problem: Students and parents need to find information across college pages and documents. This project explores a conversational way to access that material while keeping official sources available for checking.
features: English, Urdu and Roman Urdu interaction
Source cards linking to public college material
A searchable college guide and dated saved-information fallbacks
Conversation management, optional local saving and Markdown export
Responsive interface, theme switching and contextual follow-ups
Shared model-call coordination and provider cooldowns across server instances
architecture: Public college material + Gemini File Search
projects.contribution: Developed with an AI-assisted workflow, with hands-on work in testing, builds, debugging and deployment. The source includes knowledge maintenance and operational documentation.
projects.verification: 24 October 2026: 410 automated tests, type checks and the production build passed. Shared MongoDB readiness was verified on the live deployment. Three final sampled live checks passed, including Roman Urdu location, campus rules and a private-record request boundary. Simple address questions use the saved official contact page without spending provider quota. Earlier reading-position checks confirm new answers stay at their beginning.
limitations: An independent student project; it is not presented as an official college service.
Confirm fees, dates, eligibility and other time-sensitive information with the college.
Generated answers depend on the external model service and the freshness of the retrieved material.
try: Open the live demo and browse the college guide.
Ask about a program or admission topic in your preferred supported language.
Open the source links and verify any time-sensitive information.
next: Maintain the knowledge snapshots and confirm time-sensitive details against official sources.
Monitor provider quotas and real user feedback; free-provider availability remains an external dependency.
setup: Read the repository README and environment example.
Install the pinned Node dependencies and configure required server-side provider settings privately.
Run the documented checks and production build before deploying to Vercel.
projects.statusDetail: Shared provider protection verified · sourced answers and saved college guide

projects.name: Shape Up
projects.tagline: A place for everyday fitness progress.
projects.summary: A MERN fitness project with personal daily logs, workout tools, nutrition features and calculators in one application.
projects.imageAlt: Shape Up home page with Train Smarter, Live Better headline
projects.problem: Fitness information and daily progress are easy to scatter across different tools. Shape Up brings personal logs, exercise browsing and basic calculators into one learning project.
features: Account registration, login and personal profile
Daily logs for water, steps, calories and weight
Workout database and fitness calculators
Nutrition-related tools and progress views
AI coaching with conversation context, bounded retries and clear provider-error states
Full account data export and password-confirmed permanent account deletion
Authenticated support email, shared theme and device reminder preferences
projects.contribution: Built as a full-stack learning project. Launch work includes a serverless entrypoint, reusable database connections, request limits, deployment configuration and a visible demo notice. The professional repository retains the original history and attribution.
projects.verification: 24 October 2026: 27 backend and 14 frontend tests passed again. Seven fresh live account/log/access checks passed after redeployment, and a live AI response succeeded. The 57 defined synthetic workflow checks and owner-confirmed support inbox delivery from 20–21 October remain recorded in the release history; those 57 were not all rerun on this date.
limitations: AI coaching is enabled. Free provider quotas and outages can still interrupt generation; the interface reports service errors clearly.
Support email is enabled for signed-in users and rate limited. Use invented sample details when exploring.
Fitness and nutrition outputs are project demonstrations, not individual medical guidance.
Browser reminders require the app to remain open. Motion step counting is an estimate on supported phones; manual entry is available.
try: Browse workouts or try a calculator without signing in.
Create an account using invented sample details.
Save a daily water or steps log and check that it appears again.
next: Keep provider quotas, dependencies and data backups maintained.
Review genuine user feedback and extend features without overstating demo capabilities.
setup: Install backend and frontend dependencies using the repository instructions.
Configure MONGO_URI and a strong JWT_SECRET privately; use a dedicated demo database.

Configure GEMINI_API_KEY privately and set AI_ENABLED=true after testing. Optional support email uses private EMAIL_USER and EMAIL_PASS settings; enable EMAIL_ENABLED only after delivery verification.
Build the frontend and deploy the repository’s Vercel configuration.
projects.statusDetail: Account, fitness and AI flows checked · support email delivery confirmed

projects.name: TechNova
projects.summary: A Flutter electronics shopping application, branded Laptop Harbour in the app, with catalog browsing, comparison, a cart and demonstration checkout. Try the application through its browser demo.
projects.imageAlt: TechNova Flutter application shown at a phone screen size, with shopping categories, catalog and bottom navigation
projects.problem: An e-commerce application connects many small interactions: discovering products, comparing options, changing quantities and recording an order. TechNova explores that end-to-end interface using Flutter and Firebase.
features: Electronics catalog, categories and search
Product details and product comparison
Cart with quantity management
Firebase authentication and customer record workflows
Admin inventory screens and demonstration order flow
Persistent administrator-managed categories shared across catalog and search
Authenticated AI shopping assistance through a private server
Signed image uploads for customer avatars and administrator catalog media
Private review submissions with administrator-approved public feedback
architecture: Node service routes · Firebase ID-token verification · private Gemini / Cloudinary credentials
projects.contribution: Launch work restored web configuration, added explicit demo behavior, removed automatic public catalog seeding, tested Firestore access rules and fixed a cart quantity issue. The Flutter interface also exposes browser accessibility semantics. The October 24 integration update moved AI and media uploads behind verified customer sessions, added administrator moderation for public reviews and published Android 3.0.2.
projects.verification: 24 October 2026: four Flutter tests, 12 Node service tests and 35 Firestore emulator access/privacy checks passed. Twelve new live checks verified a signed-in Gemini reply, a signed Cloudinary sample upload and retrieval, authentication, catalog-upload restrictions and private review protection. Flutter analysis is clean; web and Android 3.0.2 builds, APK metadata, signature and upload checksum were verified. The owner handles fresh physical Android and iOS/browser testing; native iOS is not supplied.
limitations: Demo checkout only: no real payment processing or fulfillment.
AI and image services depend on free provider quotas/availability. Burst limits are per warm server process. Public reviews appear only after administrator approval.

Android 3.0.2 physical testing is handled by the owner. Earlier installation/login was confirmed on 18 October. iPhone/iPad use the browser demo via Add to Home Screen; no native iOS package is supplied.
try: Open the live catalog, select a category and search for a product.
Open product details, choose a quantity and add it to the cart.
Explore demonstration checkout using sample information only; no purchase is made.
next: Maintain provider quotas, moderation and the pinned Flutter/Android dependencies.
The owner handles physical Android and iOS/browser checks; native iOS distribution remains separate.
setup: Install the pinned Flutter and Node dependencies; configure your own Firebase project and tested access rules.
Save Gemini and Cloudinary credentials privately on the server host. Never put provider secrets in Dart, APK or browser files.
Build Flutter web assets, then deploy with the root Vercel configuration so API routes and the browser app run together.
Use the existing administrator role to maintain catalog data and approve safe review text.
projects.statusDetail: Android 3.0.2 · private AI and image services live-checked · moderated reviews

projects.name: EduPredict
projects.tagline: Making educational data easier to explore.
projects.summary: A Python and Flask educational analytics project with role-based dashboards, data workflows and synthetic prediction examples.
projects.imageAlt: EduPredict's read-only analytics showcase with clearly labeled synthetic profiles and a sample CSV download
projects.problem: Educational records can be difficult to turn into clear summaries. This learning project explores data preparation, role-based views and predictive examples using synthetic student data.
features: Student registration and current-role access checks
Owner-scoped CSV uploads, charts and demonstration model training
MongoDB-backed CSV reports and assignment attachments
Assigned-cohort submission and teacher grading workflows
Synthetic risk, grade and demand examples
A public read-only analytics showcase and synthetic sample CSV download
Owner-configured SMTP notifications with shared sending limits and validated support inquiries
projects.contribution: Release work moved credentials out of source, removed default accounts and made new uploads, reports and attachments durable across serverless restarts. Ownership checks scope staff data and cohort workflows, while revoked roles and old password sessions are rejected.
projects.verification: 24 October 2026: 38 isolated tests passed across durable data, staff ownership/cohort boundaries, sessions, input validation, public showcase and SMTP delivery guards. Eight earlier live student/account checks and the public showcase/sample download passed. The configured SMTP service accepted a synthetic support message and the owner confirmed it reached the inbox. Staff workflows used isolated synthetic fixtures; real institutional predictive accuracy is not established.
limitations: Use synthetic data only. Model demonstrations are not evidence of real-world student prediction accuracy.
The risk score includes a heuristic; it is not a calibrated dropout probability.
Public registration creates student accounts. Staff analytics are restricted; no public administrator password is supplied.

Email is limited to owner-configured inboxes, shared sending caps and provider availability. New uploads/reports/attachments are stored in MongoDB; legacy local-file records require migration or re-upload.
try: Open the public analytics showcase and download its synthetic sample CSV.
Register with invented sample details and sign in to the student area.
Update your sample profile. Read the source for restricted staff workflows.
next: Maintain synthetic data, account roles, owner-approved recipient inboxes and dependency versions.
Keep the read-only showcase and operating notes aligned with application changes.
setup: Install the pinned Python dependencies and read the repository setup notes.
Set MONGO_URI, DB_NAME and a strong SECRET_KEY privately. Optional SMTP uses EMAIL_USER, EMAIL_PASSWORD and owner-configured recipient inboxes; enable only after configuration.
Use synthetic datasets and deliberately provision any staff roles; public registration is student-only.
Deploy the Flask entrypoint with the provided Vercel configuration. New records use bounded MongoDB-backed storage; migrate any legacy local-file records.
projects.statusDetail: Durable data workflows · 38 isolated checks · owner-configured email
